1: // Simple Asteroid Dodge game
2: // Canvas element with id="game" is expected in the HTML.
3: (() => {
4:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
5:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas with id "game" not found');
6:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
7:   // Set a default size if not defined in HTML/CSS
8:   canvas.width = canvas.width || 800;
9:   canvas.height = canvas.height || 600;
10: 
11:   // Ship definition
12:   const ship = {
13:     width: 40,
14:     height: 20,
15:     x: canvas.width / 2 - 20,
16:     y: canvas.height - 30,
17:     speed: 5,
18:     moveLeft: false,
19:     moveRight: false,
20:   };
21: 
22:   // Asteroid pool
23:   const asteroids = [];
24:   let asteroidSpawnTimer = 0;
25:   let asteroidSpawnInterval = 1000; // ms
26:   let lastTime = 0;
27:   let gameOver = false;
28: 
29:   // Power‑up (optional, simple shield)
30:   const powerUps = [];
31:   let shield = false;
32:   let shieldTimer = 0;
33: 
34:   // Input handling
35:   window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
36:     if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') ship.moveLeft = true;
37:     if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') ship.moveRight = true;
38:   });
39:   window.addEventListener('keyup', (e) => {
40:     if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') ship.moveLeft = false;
41:     if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') ship.moveRight = false;
42:   });
43: 
44:   function spawnAsteroid() {
45:     const size = Math.random() * 30 + 20;
46:     const x = Math.random() * (canvas.width - size);
47:     const speed = 2 + Math.random() * 2 + asteroids.length * 0.05; // increase over time
48:     asteroids.push({ x, y: -size, size, speed });
49:   }
50: 
51:   function spawnPowerUp() {
52:     const size = 20;
53:     const x = Math.random() * (canvas.width - size);
54:     const speed = 1.5;
55:     powerUps.push({ x, y: -size, size, speed, type: 'shield' });
56:   }
57: 
58:   function update(delta) {
59:     // move ship
60:     if (ship.moveLeft) ship.x -= ship.speed;
61:     if (ship.moveRight) ship.x += ship.speed;
62:     // keep within bounds
63:     ship.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(canvas.width - ship.width, ship.x));
64: 
65:     // spawn asteroids
66:     asteroidSpawnTimer += delta;
67:     if (asteroidSpawnTimer > asteroidSpawnInterval) {
68:       spawnAsteroid();
69:       asteroidSpawnTimer = 0;
70:       // occasional power‑up
71:       if (Math.random() < 0.1) spawnPowerUp();
72:     }
73: 
74:     // update asteroids
75:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
76:       const a = asteroids[i];
77:       a.y += a.speed;
78:       // remove off‑screen
79:       if (a.y > canvas.height) asteroids.splice(i, 1);
80:     }
81: 
82:     // update power‑ups
83:     for (let i = powerUps.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
84:       const p = powerUps[i];
85:       p.y += p.speed;
86:       if (p.y > canvas.height) powerUps.splice(i, 1);
87:     }
88: 
89:     // shield timer
90:     if (shield) {
91:       shieldTimer -= delta;
92:       if (shieldTimer <= 0) shield = false;
93:     }
94: 
95:     // collision detection
96:     // ship rectangle
97:     const shipRect = { x: ship.x, y: ship.y, w: ship.width, h: ship.height };
98:     // asteroids
99:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
100:       const a = asteroids[i];
101:       const aRect = { x: a.x, y: a.y, w: a.size, h: a.size };
102:       if (rectIntersect(shipRect, aRect)) {
103:         if (shield) {
104:           // destroy asteroid, keep shield
105:           asteroids.splice(i, 1);
106:           shield = false; // shield used up
107:         } else {
108:           gameOver = true;
109:         }
110:       }
111:     }
112:     // power‑ups
113:     for (let i = powerUps.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
114:       const p = powerUps[i];
115:       const pRect = { x: p.x, y: p.y, w: p.size, h: p.size };
116:       if (rectIntersect(shipRect, pRect)) {
117:         if (p.type === 'shield') {
118:           shield = true;
119:           shieldTimer = 5000; // 5 seconds
120:         }
121:         powerUps.splice(i, 1);
122:       }
123:     }
124:   }
125: 
126:   function rectIntersect(r1, r2) {
127:     return !(r2.x > r1.x + r1.w ||
128:              r2.x + r2.w < r1.x ||
129:              r2.y > r1.y + r1.h ||
130:              r2.y + r2.h < r1.y);
131:   }
132: 
133:   function draw() {
134:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
135:     // ship
136:     ctx.fillStyle = shield ? 'cyan' : 'white';
137:     ctx.fillRect(ship.x, ship.y, ship.width, ship.height);
138:     // asteroids
139:     ctx.fillStyle = 'gray';
140:     for (const a of asteroids) {
141:       ctx.beginPath();
142:       ctx.arc(a.x + a.size / 2, a.y + a.size / 2, a.size / 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
143:       ctx.fill();
144:     }
145:     // power‑ups
146:     ctx.fillStyle = 'gold';
147:     for (const p of powerUps) {
148:       ctx.fillRect(p.x, p.y, p.size, p.size);
149:     }
150:     // Game over text
151:     if (gameOver) {
152:       ctx.fillStyle = 'red';
153:       ctx.font = '48px sans-serif';
154:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
155:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2);
156:     }
157:   }
158: 
159:   function loop(timestamp) {
160:     if (!lastTime) lastTime = timestamp;
161:     const delta = timestamp - lastTime;
162:     lastTime = timestamp;
163:     if (!gameOver) update(delta);
164:     draw();
165:     if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
166:   }
167: 
168:   // start the game
169:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
170: })();

(End of file - total 170 lines)
</content>
